People: Elizabeth Barrett Browning (author, Wikidata Q228494), died 1861. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Browning, Elizabeth Barrett, 1806-1861") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Sonnets from the Portuguese, New York, Duffield & company, 1909, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/sonnetsfromportu02brow. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 73%, 94%, 94% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Elizabeth Barrett Browning, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
